name: cleanapp
description: Find and report physical and digital problems with CleanApp. Preview a report, submit it for private review, and track its receipt.

interface.longDescription: Turn an observed problem into a clear, trackable report. Find existing public reports about potholes, litter, illegal dumping, accessibility barriers, damaged infrastructure, pollution, software bugs, suspected scams, and service issues. Preview your report before sending it to CleanApp’s private review lane, then check its intake receipt. No CleanApp account is needed. Reports are not automatically published or forwarded to responsible parties, and CleanApp is not an emergency service.
defaultPrompt: Help me report a blocked sidewalk.
Help me report a bug in an app.
